info.name: Condux API
info.description:
Official Postman collection for the **Condux** API, generated from `contracts/openapi.json`.

## Base URL
Set the `baseUrl` variable (defaults to the managed cloud `https://app.condux.ai`), or select the
bundled **Condux — Local dev** environment to point at a local `pnpm dev` stack.

## Auth
Condux uses a **cookie session**, not a bearer token. Run **Auth → login** once with your email and
password; the response sets an HttpOnly `condux_session` cookie that Postman's cookie jar stores and
sends automatically on every later request to the same host. Sign out with **Auth → logout**.

## Sending events
The **Ingest** folder posts a test error to the relay (a different host, `ingestBaseUrl`). Set
`projectPublicId` and `dsnKey` from a project DSN (`scheme://<dsnKey>@<host>/<projectPublicId>`).
